title: Why more AG data stops helping: the residual failures
question: Which failures remain at the ~85% plateau, is their fix in the data, and do labels point at it?
headline: Late failures: second pot placed too late 40%, hand stalls low beside the second pot 23%, pot lost/tipped 17%. Recovery from a lost/tipped pot is nearly absent from 1,600 training episodes; late-round negatives are 65-75% successful episodes; base rollouts are 58% of labelled frames.
not_covered: mid-task starts at the second pot and from knocked/tipped pots
